purpose: Each entry neuters exactly one fail-closed rejection or threshold and names the tests that must fail because of it. The literal must occur exactly once in the file; an entry that does not apply cleanly is reported as indeterminate rather than as a caught mutation.

mutations.summary: Two different events claiming one sequence_no must be rejected, not silently folded.
A persisted single-run event log whose sequence_no is not contiguous from zero must be refused on read.
One entity_id may not change its entity_type mid-run; the fold must refuse it.
A confidence outside [0, 1] or a non-finite confidence must be rejected.
mutations.literal: if not math.isfinite(confidence_value) or not 0.0 <= confidence_value <= 1.0:

mutations.summary: The whole raw-control identifier check must keep denying parameter identifiers; the generated corpus and the declared spellings must both notice its removal.
configure() may only succeed from the created state.
An acknowledgement whose result, fault and mode disagree must be rejected.
mutations.literal: if not valid_partition or not valid_result:

mutations.summary: A command frame whose reserved bytes are non-zero must be rejected.

excluded_paths.firmware/**: AGENTS.md keeps firmware/ out of AI write tasks, and a probe edits the file even though the edit is confined to a throwaway copy. The VirtualMcu boundary is still covered by tests/property/test_property_state_transitions.py, which only reads it.
excluded_paths.robot/control/**: AGENTS.md keeps robot/control/ out of AI write tasks, and a probe edits the file even inside the copy. Motion boundaries are owned by their own validation suite.
